checklist_item.title: Supporting Check: Can integer overflow in FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_CELL * cell_index bypass bounds checking or cause unexpected array access?

checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Identify the types of cell_index and FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_CELL constants. 2. Craft test cases with cell_index values that cause integer overflow in the multiplication. 6. Send via P2P and observe behavior: does it crash, reject, or silently use wrong data? 7. If the multiplication uses checked arithmetic (checked_mul), verify overflow returns error rather than proceeding. 8. Verify bounds check (cell_index < CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB) occurs BEFORE the multiplication, preventing overflow entirely.
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W5B14-10, Trust Boundary: tb-002. If bounds check occurs after multiplication, attacker could cause overflow. Proper order: 1) check cell_index < CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB, 2) only then compute FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_CELL * cell_index.
